notes:
v0.6.16: BUILD.md recipe prerequisite fixes (caught during clean build).

Operator was running the clean build on a fresh Pi (hostname
`reticulumpi` — the v0.6.14 hostname fix from b3205bf took).
Two `cp: cannot create regular file` errors at Step 4:

1. `/home/pi/.config/pat/config.json` — pat's config dir only
   exists after pat's first run. Recipe was missing the
   `mkdir -p` prerequisite.

2. `/home/pi/patmenu2/start-pat-ardop` — `/home/pi/patmenu2/`
   doesn't exist because patmenu2 is an external project
   the recipe assumes the operator has cloned. Recipe was
   missing the `git clone https://github.com/la5nta/patmenu2.git`
   prerequisite.

Two new steps added to BUILD.md Step 4 (before the existing
overlay cp blocks):
- 1b: `git clone https://github.com/la5nta/patmenu2.git /home/pi/patmenu2`
- 1c: `mkdir -p /home/pi/.config/pat`

Also bumped the pinned version in Step 4.1a from v0.6.12 to
v0.6.15 (the current latest at the time of the fix).

No code changes — docs only. Manifest components unchanged.
Overlay unchanged. Pure recipe hygiene.

Note: the original recipe is for v0.6.12 because that's the
version the operator was testing when they hit the errors.
The prerequisite fix is independent of which version is pinned.
